name: Nevada SB 276 (2025): local governments must notify NDEP of sewage discharges; NDEP notifies affected tribes
access_detail: Enrolled text fetched; signed 2025-05-31 per a bill tracker (Chapter 189, not confirmed on the official site). New section of NRS chapter 445A.
status_reason: Fetched: duty to notify NDEP electronically or by telephone, no deadline stated; tribe notice by NDEP; no public notice. Codified as NRS 445A.467 (official chapter, revision of 2026-04-15, read 2026-11-09).

name: NAC 445A.345 to 445A.348 release notification (hazardous substances, spill hotline)
status_reason: Fetched: release to surface water reported "as soon as practicable" by phone; land releases over 25 gallons by the first working day.

name: NDEP Nevada Environmental Activities portal (Report a Spill)
operator: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Corrective Actions
access_detail: Fetched home page: spill reporting form, account login for case lookup; public search covers certifications only. No public spill list found. NDEP spill database is internal (2017 hotline presentation).
status_reason: Intake only (an online form and account login); no public view of the notices found. The host did not answer the collector on 2026-11-14.

name: Nevada HAB Dashboard (Office of State Epidemiology, Power BI) and weekly HAB email list
operator: Nevada HAB Task Force (NDEP, State Parks, NDOW, NDA, OSE)
access_detail: Power BI Gov embed (no API); NDEP page ndep.nv.gov/water/rivers-streams-lakes/water-quality-monitoring/harmful-algal-bloom-program; weekly updates by email list (subscribe via NDEP "Get Notices", list "Nevada Harmful Algal Bloom Updates", or NEVADAHABS-subscribe-request@LISTSERV.STATE.NV.US).
status_reason: The only statewide bloom status, a Power BI report that draws its data as a picture: no rows, no download, no data endpoint (expansion research 2026-11-09). Registered as a channel with the barrier; a supported export is an owner request.
notes: Watch/Warning advisories at Lahontan Reservoir and Washoe Lake in 2026 (news).

name: Nevada State Parks HAB advisory page
access_detail: The page's three accordion sections (HAB Watch, Warning and Danger Advisories): one bold heading per water with its update date, then the parks' paragraph; 'None at this time.' for an empty level.
cannot_fill: started_at (no issue date: the first read is used)
ended_at (no lift date: the read that finds the water gone is used)
cadence: updated when a level changes; no fixed schedule
history: current advisories only; the Internet Archive holds monthly copies since 2025-10
status_reason: Read by the nv-state-parks-hab ingester: one hab_advisory record per water while listed, the parks' level and words, the first read as the start. The live host refused the collector's connections on 2026-11-14 (no answer on ports 443 and 80); the parser was built and tested on the Internet Archive's copies of 2025-11-12 (Rye Patch Watch, Lahontan Warning) and 2026-08-13 (Lahontan, Rye Patch, Marlette Lake and Washoe Lake Watch).
notes: Waters in Nevada state parks only.

name: NPS Lake Mead NRA HAB page
status_reason: Readable page of general advice; its page date is not an advisory date. Watched without records (register row nv-nps-lake-mead-habs).

name: EPA ECHO SOBE (Nevada)
status_reason: No Nevada events and no Nevada collection systems in the current and all-versions extracts of 2026-11-12 (rechecked at the build).

name: Lake Tahoe beach bacteria monitoring
status_reason: The Nevada Tahoe Conservation District's Nearshore Human Health page describes the monitoring with a 2023 report; its Lake Tahoe Info program page gave no readable results (2026-11-09). No current station results or closures found.

name: Reno/Sparks Truckee River sewage spill coverage (News 4, KNPR)
status_reason: The 2022 Sparks spill (estimates 214,000 to 2.5 million gallons to the Truckee) went unreported to NDEP and led to SB 276.

name: NDEP harmful algal bloom program page
status_reason: Program page linking the statewide dashboard and the weekly e-mail update; watched for a data download (register row nv-ndep-hab-program).

name: NDEP Water Quality Data Warehouse
status_reason: Station results behind a search form; results and downloads not exercised. Samples, not notices.

name: NDEP public document search (OnBase)
status_reason: Not all record series are online; whether sewage incident files are searchable was not verified. A records request for the NRS 445A.467 notices is the route.

name: Southern Nevada Water Authority watershed monitoring
status_reason: Lake Mead and Colorado River monitoring; the regional database is offered by e-mail request. Samples, not notices.

name: City of Reno Environmental Control (spill line)
status_reason: A telephone spill line and a record holder; no published list of overflows.
